newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian O/N rates ease to end at 22.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian O/N rates ease to end at 22.75 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight interest rates closed down at 22.75 percent from Friday's close of 23 percent, traders said.

"The fall is nothing exceptional," said Friedrich Brandt of Commerzbank. "It's a normal pattern for the rates to be just below the short-term floor of 23 percent." he added, referring to the current one-week reverse repo rate.
Traders expect the slight downward trend to probably be offset by the tax payments beginning on Monday.
